agents.name: ExpenseReportAnalyst
agents.instructions: Analyze the uploaded Expense CSV attachment. It is delivered as a sandbox file path, so read the file with Python before answering. Summarize spending by category, identify the largest expense, and return a concise explanation. You must also produce the Expense Summary attachment as valid JSON with keys category_totals, largest_expense, and recommendations. The output attachment name and file_type must exactly match its declared attachment node: Expense Summary and json.

attachments.name: Expense CSV
attachments.description: Upload a CSV expense export with date, merchant, category, and amount columns.

attachments.name: Expense Summary
attachments.description: A JSON expense analysis produced after processing the uploaded CSV.
